visual.general_description: Dual-axis line chart titled Treatment and Clinical Course with PANSS-Total and GAF series, three labelled drug bars and a BMT marker.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background chart is titled "Treatment and Clinical Course". Identical numeric scales from 0 to 120 in steps of 20 are printed at the left and right edges, and a horizontal axis labelled "Month" prints tick labels 2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42, 46, 50, 54, 60 and 64 at alternate tick marks. A red-brown line with square markers is labelled "PANSS-Total"; it fluctuates with a general decline across the markers before an orange-outlined box reading "BMT" with a red downward arrow, then falls abruptly right after that marker and continues as a flat run of markers to the right end. A purple line with square markers is labelled "GAF"; before the BMT marker it shows small up-and-down fluctuations, then rises steeply right after the marker, continues to rise more slowly and then flattens with slight increases toward the right end. The two lines cross once, after the BMT marker. Three horizontal bars lie to the left of the BMT arrow: a blue bar reading "QTP  800 mg/day", a green bar reading "RIS  12 mg/day" and a yellow bar reading "OLZ  20 mg/day". The blue bar begins first and ends earlier than the green and yellow bars; the green bar begins before the yellow bar; the green and yellow bars end at about the same horizontal extent as each other. No individual point values, patient names, dates or panel letters are printed.
